title: KaribuEHR onboarding
subtitle: Learn every role before your first real patient.

modules.title: Register a patient
modules.subtitle: Records desk — search, register, and open a chart
modules.coach_intro: Every visit starts at the front desk. You'll learn where to register a patient and start a visit on your phone — no real data is saved during training.

modules.title: Record vitals
modules.subtitle: Nurse — capture vitals on the patient timeline
modules.coach_intro: You're assigned as a nurse, but every staff member should know this flow. Watch where vitals are entered before the clinician sees the patient.

modules.title: Note & send to pharmacy
modules.subtitle: Clinician — document and submit a pharmacy order
modules.coach_intro: The clinician documents the visit and can send to pharmacy while the note is still open. This is how KaribuEHR works in a busy HC III.

modules.title: Record a lab result
modules.subtitle: Lab tech — work the lab queue on your phone
modules.coach_intro: Even if you're not the lab tech, you should know what they see. Lab results flow back to the chart automatically.
modules.web_bonus: On the web app you get a wider lab desk view with batch actions.

modules.title: Dispense & manage stock
modules.subtitle: Dispenser — pharmacy queue and stock
modules.coach_intro: Pharmacy opens when the clinician sends an order — not when the note is signed. Learn the dispenser home and stock screen.
modules.web_bonus: The web pharmacy desk shows the full formulary and inventory in one view.

modules.title: Record a payment
modules.subtitle: Front desk — billing without blocking care
modules.coach_intro: Payment is separate from signing the note. Any staff can record a payment when the clinic is ready to collect.
modules.web_bonus: Web billing gives itemized charges and printable receipts.
